resource.name: directory-service
resource.description: The company directory that is the system of record for employees, teams and reporting lines. The claims API resolves the signed-in caller's record by their username and looks up their manager, so every submitted claim routes to the right approver without anyone picking one by hand.

suggestions.name: Microsoft Entra ID
suggestions.description: Employee profiles and manager attributes through the Graph API, if the organization already runs Entra as its directory.

suggestions.name: Google Workspace Directory
suggestions.description: People API with manager relations, if the organization runs Google Workspace.

suggestions.name: Workday
suggestions.description: HR system of record with worker and management-chain data, common in larger companies.

suggestions.name: BambooHR
suggestions.description: Lightweight HR directory with employee-manager relationships, common in smaller companies.
